additional_info.subject: RE: ID0386084-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / R1 170001176] Charging process is interrupted in DC1 CRM:01811000395
additional_info.body:
Dear Emre,
I hope all is well with you. I'm Sambath, and I'll be supporting you on this case from expert team. Please be aware that I have completed analysis on this charger for the last month and understand there is an issue with the DC1 connector. Out of 45 charging sessions, approx. 20 of them are interrupting with cable temperature plausibility errors. It is clear from the logs that the connector is not working properly at high charging current (above 375 A). Please find the attached working for your reference and proceed to replace the connector. Request you to align with me during your site visit to have a visual inspection of the faulty connector.
1 month error analysis:
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sambath.K.S
